headline: Markets closed for weekend as global news highlights gold selloff and Anthropic IPO demand

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 23 November.

why: Gold logged its worst week since March due to a hawkish Federal Reserve and AI stock selloffs.
Donald Trump criticized the Federal Reserve for being political, asking observers to look at India.
Anthropic's IPO saw massive interest, drawing $120 billion in retail demand and surpassing SpaceX.
Nikhil Kamath discussed emerging business ideas and opportunities in the tomato supply chain.
whatHappening: Gold prices faced pressure during the week amid shifting central bank expectations.
Global tech sentiment was buoyed by high-profile AI IPO activity.
GTA 6 recorded $3.8 billion in first-day sales, setting entertainment launch records.
Operation Mole starring Dhanush opened strong at the box office, grossing Rs 31.55 crore worldwide on Day 1.
summary:
Indian markets are closed today for the weekend and will reopen on Monday, 23 November.
Recent global updates highlight gold recording its worst week since March amid a hawkish Fed.
Other news includes record retail demand for Anthropic's IPO and entertainment industry milestones.
